params.body:
Elixir writes the gateway's configuration, which is carried over to the gateway. This adds one block to it:

```json
"revocations": {"url": "https://portal.abovebeyond.ai/api/ingest/control/revoked"}
```

With it, the gateway reads Portal's list of capabilities the owner ended before they expired, and refuses an action under one (control#107, `cmd/gateway/revoked.go`; Portal serves the list since portal#375). Without the block, a gateway on v0.35.0 behaves as before. The block is always written: unlike `policy_log`, it needs nothing from the DID document, and it only takes away.

It takes effect at the next carry-over, together with the upgrade to v0.35.0.

Test: `ControlPolicyLogTest` asserts the block in the written configuration. The full suite passes, 720 tests.
params.title: Gateway configuration: read the revoked capabilities from Portal
